scoring_justification: The group-theoretical decomposition at Gamma point for this specific crystal structure yields a unique set of integer multiplicities and tensor patterns. Comparing the agent's submitted counts and tensor patterns against the paper's reported values provides a reliable gold. Full recomputation from first principles in the checker is heavy; result-level compare is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold: expected irrep decomposition counts, acoustic/optical mode classification, Raman tensor forms as reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'A Raman study of the Peierls transition in (TaSe4)2I', Solid State Communications, 56, 947 (1985). Decomposition given in section 2, Table 1, and text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed exactly from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results, used as the reference for reproduction.

irrep_decomposition.description: Multiplicities of irreducible representations A1, A2, B1, B2, E

total_modes.description: Total number of vibrational degrees of freedom (66)

acoustic_modes.description: Acoustic mode irreps with degeneracies (A2=1, E=2)

optical_modes.description: Optical mode classification including IR_active (A2 count), Raman_active (A1, B1, B2, E counts), and boolean note E_also_IR_active

raman_tensor_forms.description: Raman polarizability tensor forms for A1, B1, B2, E (E has two matrices)

schema.notes: The checker will recompute the decomposition from the public structural information and compare the integer multiplicities exactly and the Raman tensor forms for structural pattern correctness.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the full group-theoretical decomposition and Raman tensor forms.

output_contract.notes: The agent must produce the decomposition from first principles using the correlation method; the checker will independently recompute the decomposition and verify integer counts and tensor patterns. No numeric convergence tolerances apply to integer counts.

rubric.description: Check irrep decomposition, acoustic/optical classification, and Raman tensor forms against paper-reported gold.

sub_checks.name: total_modes
sub_checks.details: total_modes == 66 and sum of irrep counts == 66

sub_checks.name: optical
sub_checks.details: optical_modes: IR_active A2=8, Raman_active A1=7, B1=7, B2=7, E=17, E_also_IR_active=True

sub_checks.name: tensor_patterns
sub_checks.details: Tensor forms: A1 diag(a,a,b), B1 diag(c,-c,0), B2 off-diagonal (0 d 0; d 0 0; 0 0 0), E two matrices with e components at (1,3) and (3,1) for one, (2,3) and (3,2) for the other.
